lines.en: What are you going to do this weekend?
I am going to visit my family on Friday.
We are meeting some friends for dinner tonight.
She is starting a new job next month.
I will probably travel abroad next year.
They are moving to a new apartment soon.
Are you coming to the party on Saturday?
I am not doing anything special tomorrow.
We hope to buy a car by the end of the year.
One day, I want to open my own business.
